kypExtensions.summary: The pool-balance reading of the printed bathtub figure: prevalence is the WATER LEVEL (a stock, # of existing cases at a point in time over the total population), set by two INFLOWS (INCIDENCE — the faucet, # of new cases per # of people at risk per unit of time; RECURRENCE — the return loop of relapsing cases re-entering from the cure side) and two OUTFLOWS (MORTALITY and CURE — the drains); the level rises when inflow beats outflow, and at steady state level ≈ faucet × stay, which is the printed identity 'Prevalence / (1 – prevalence) = Incidence rate × average duration of disease' simplified to 'Prevalence = incidence × duration of the disease.'
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the figure, its five labels, and the formulas as parallel facts; the stock-vs-flow framing, the in/out classification of the four streams, the balance logic, and the level ≈ faucet × stay derivation are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.what + core.why + core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] pool-balance-map + the registry visual's Zone A (pool, streams, balance card) + compare block

kypExtensions.summary: The two-lever router for the 8-row situation table: every situation pulls ONE lever — THE FLOW (new-case generation: extensive vaccine administration, ↓ risk factors, ↓ contact → incidence ↓ and prevalence ↓), THE STAY (average duration: ↑ survival time lengthens it → prevalence ↑; ↑ mortality rate, faster recovery time, new effective treatment shorten it → prevalence ↓; all four print '—' for incidence), or THE COUNTING (↑ diagnostic sensitivity → both ↑ — a measurement artifact, not more disease) — plus the printed regularities: '—' appears only in the INCIDENCE column, and prevalence moves in all eight rows.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the eight glyph pairs without a generating rule; the flow/stay/counting router, the measurement-artifact reading of the sensitivity row, and the column regularities are KYP's organization.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[1] situation-router-map + blocks[2] the 8-row decoder list + blocks[3] the steps block + the registry visual's lever tags and rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the survival-extension stem, the measurement/sensitivity stem, the prevention stem, the pretest-probability/PPV-NPV stem), 4 traps (↑ survival vs ↑ mortality; new treatment vs vaccine; the two denominators at-risk vs total population; sensitivity-counts vs true outbreak), 3 pivots (the two-lever router, the em-dash 'no effect' as a real incidence-only answer, the prevalence→PPV/NPV conversion), and 8 recall cards covering both formulas, the identity, both anchors, the pool's four streams, and the table's glyph pairs.
